_readme: The 11 services, A-Z (az_order = position, checked by the build). path = the page it builds to (existing slugs kept). dial_order = stop on the homepage Dial, small job to big job (1-9; null = not its own stop). dial_label / dial_line override name / line on the Dial only; dial_links = services linked from that word frame (stop 02: Electrical · HVAC · Plumbing, copywriter 261015-0040 §1.2). photo = 'job/frame' from jobs.json (a published, shown frame) or null for a big-word frame; photo_pos = object-position for the full-screen crop. line = one short line (copy deck copy-deck-261015-mhcr-full-site-v1.md, the single source for copy). Each service's jobs list is derived from jobs.json `category`. h1 / intro / body (paragraphs) / does (the 'What we do' list) / meta_title / meta_description = the service page copy, verbatim from the copy deck §4. The build makes one page per service at `path` from partials/service-page.html.

services.name: Basement
services.meta_title: Basement Finishing in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Basement finishing around Denver. We frame, wire, drywall and finish bare basements, down to the floors and trim. Free quote: (720) 492-4326.
services.intro: We turn bare concrete basements into finished rooms.
body: We frame the walls, run the wiring, hang and finish the drywall, then put down the floors and trim.
We work around the posts, ducts and windows that are already there, and lay out the rooms for how you'll use them.

services.name: Bathroom
services.meta_title: Bathroom Remodeling in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Custom tiled showers built by hand, plus tub surrounds, tile floors and vanities, for homes around Denver. Free quote: (720) 492-4326.
services.intro: Custom tiled showers built by hand, plus tub surrounds, tile floors and vanities.
body: Our showers are custom built on site, one phase at a time. We build the curb, then pour and level the mud pan by hand.
Then we fit the liner, waterproof the walls, and cut and set the tile one piece at a time.
We also do tub surrounds, tile floors, vanities, faucets and toilets, for a small update or the whole room.

services.name: Bedroom
services.meta_title: Bedroom Renovation in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Board-and-batten accent walls, closets, flooring, trim and lighting for bedrooms around Denver. Free quote: (720) 492-4326.
services.intro: Accent walls, trim, closets and floors, for one wall or the whole room.
body: A bedroom job can start with one wall. For board-and-batten, we lay out the grid on the wall and cut each board to fit.
We also do closets, flooring, trim, painting, lighting and ceiling fans.

services.name: Drywall
services.meta_title: Drywall Repair in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Drywall patches, water-damaged drywall replaced, and new walls hung and finished, around Denver. Free quote: (720) 492-4326.
services.intro: Patches, repairs and new walls, as a job on its own or part of a remodel.
body: We patch holes and cracks, cut out and replace water-damaged drywall, and hang new walls. Then we tape and finish the seams so the walls are ready for paint.
does: New walls hung, taped and finished

services.name: Electrical
services.meta_title: Electrical Work in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Outlets, switches, new circuits, lighting and ceiling fans, as a single repair or part of a remodel, around Denver. Free quote: (720) 492-4326.
services.intro: Outlets, lighting and wiring, for one repair or a full remodel.
body: Call us about one outlet that quit or the wiring for a whole basement. We put in outlets, switches and new circuits, light fixtures, recessed lights and ceiling fans.
does: Light fixtures, recessed lights and ceiling fans

services.name: Emergency services
services.line: Leaks, water damage and small fixes
services.meta_title: Emergency Repairs in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Water leaks, water damage, electrical problems and small fixes around the house, in the Denver area. No charge to come look. Call (720) 492-4326.
services.intro: Leaks, water damage, electrical problems and small fixes around the house.
body: If it can't wait, call (720) 492-4326 and tell us what's going on. For anything urgent, please call instead of using the form. We don't charge to come look at a job, big or small.
If water is coming in, shut off the main water valve, then call us.
If you smell gas, get everyone out of the house. Then, from outside, call 911 and Xcel Energy at 1-800-895-2999. For smoke or a burning smell, call 911.
We also take care of the small fixes on your list. No job is too small.
does: Water leaks: a pipe, faucet or ceiling that's dripping
Water damage: wet drywall, ceilings and floors
Electrical problems: outlets that quit, breakers that keep tripping
Small fixes: sticking doors, loose trim, cabinet doors that hang crooked

services.name: Full home
services.meta_title: Whole Home Renovation in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Whole home renovation around Denver: several rooms or the whole house, planned and built as one job. Free quote: (720) 492-4326.
services.intro: Several rooms or the whole house, planned and built as one job.
body: Some jobs are one room. Some are the whole house. When it's several rooms, we plan the work as one job and do it in the right order.
does: Hardwood and tile floors through the house
Electrical, plumbing and HVAC as part of the job

services.name: HVAC
services.meta_title: HVAC Services in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Furnaces, air conditioning, ductwork, vents and returns around Denver, including duct changes for finished basements. Free quote: (720) 492-4326.
services.intro: Furnaces, AC and ductwork, including the changes a remodel needs.
body: We take on heating and cooling jobs: furnaces, AC units, new ductwork, and adding or moving vents and returns.
When a basement gets finished, the ducts often have to change too. We take care of that as part of the job.
does: Heating and cooling for finished basements

services.name: Kitchen
services.meta_title: Kitchen Remodeling in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Kitchen remodeling around Denver: painted cabinets, crown molding, stone-wrapped peninsulas, lighting, floors and full remodels. Free quote.
services.intro: Cabinet painting, crown molding, stone, lighting and floors, up to a full remodel.
body: Not every kitchen needs a tear-out. Painting the cabinets you have, adding crown molding and cutting a half wall down can change the room.
When it needs more than that, we do the full remodel. Either way, we'll tell you what's worth doing and what isn't.
The stone and trim work is custom, cut and fit by hand on site.
does: Cabinet painting, crown molding and under-cabinet lights
Half walls cut down and counters extended
Stone work, like a stone-wrapped peninsula

services.name: Living / dining room
services.meta_title: Fireplace Remodeling in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Stacked stone and river rock fireplace walls, accent walls, floors and lighting for living and dining rooms around Denver. Free quote: (720) 492-4326.
services.intro: Stone fireplace walls, accent walls, trim, floors and lighting.
body: A stone fireplace wall is custom work. We set the stone by hand and cut it to fit around the fireplace, the mantel and the switches.
We also do accent walls, trim, hardwood and tile floors, and lighting in living and dining rooms.
does: Fireplace walls in stacked stone or river rock

services.name: Plumbing
services.meta_title: Plumbing Services in Denver | Mile High Custom Remodels
services.meta_description: Leaks fixed, faucets, toilets, sinks and showers put in, and drain and supply lines moved or added, around Denver. Free quote: (720) 492-4326.
services.intro: Leaks, fixtures and new drain and supply lines, for a repair or a remodel.
body: We fix leaks, put in faucets, toilets, sinks and showers, and move or add drain and supply lines.
If water is coming in, shut off the main water valve, then call us.
does: Moving or adding drain and supply lines
